g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Window crossbar junctions sampled once; watch face is sampled first and strap endpoints within1.5mm of face dots omitted. Joined clock/watch hands retain a single central dot. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Window remains higher black frame/bars with white unraised panes. Clock/watch faces and watch straps use lower grey surfaces; outlines and hands higher black. No material or measured-height claim.
